arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Jeffrey Fisher argued racial bias undermines the Sixth Amendment right.
He noted many states already allow courts to review such evidence.
He acknowledged other identity categories might raise similar questions.
Colorado's advocate argued jury confidentiality prevents harassment and tampering.

paragraphs: The case tests whether courts may examine juror statements about racial bias. the side that brought the case argues this bias violates the Sixth Amendment. Colorado argues jury deliberations must remain confidential.

paragraphs: This dispute defines the scope of jury confidentiality. It determines whether courts can investigate racial bias in verdicts. The outcome shapes the balance between fair trials and private deliberations.
